  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id

  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'

SELECT o.payment_method,
       SUM(n.net) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0) AS umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT order_item_id,
         (quantity * unit_price_gross - discount_amount) / (1 + tax_rate) AS net
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items
) n ON oi.order_item_id = n.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
) rf ON oi.order_item_id = rf.order_item_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY o.payment_method
ORDER BY umsatz ASC, o.payment_method
LIMIT 1
